review_notes: I read the whole file and checked how the structure-valued definitions are consumed in the later proofs, using Grep for their uses. I did not run Lean. The claims are about missing simp lemmas and unfolding workarounds that I saw in the proofs. I make no claim about loops or simp failures observed in practice. There is little existing simp-set infrastructure here beyond the two @[simp] lemmas on the augmentation and evaluation iso. I did not check which of the proposed lemmas simp could prove by rfl, so the names and exact forms are suggestions that have not been compiled.

findings.excerpt:
f n := colimit.post (K.X n) G
  comm' n m _ := colimit.map_post (K.d n m) G
findings.problem: These two morphisms of complexes are defined by components, but there are no `@[simp]` component lemmas such as `colimMapComparison_f` and `ofFunctorColimitι_f`. Without them, simp cannot rewrite `(colimMapComparison G K).f n` to `colimit.post (K.X n) G`. Later proofs fall back on `dsimp only [def names]` followed by a hand-written `change` that restates the whole component goal. The same goes for `ofFunctorColimitι`, whose `f n := colimit.ι (D ⋙ eval A shape n) t` is only reachable by unfolding the definition.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp] lemma colimMapComparison_f (K) (n) : (colimMapComparison G K).f n = colimit.post (K.X n) G := rfl` and `@[simp] lemma ofFunctorColimitι_f (D) (t) (n) : (ofFunctorColimitι D t).f n = colimit.ι (D ⋙ eval A shape n) t := rfl`. Then drop the `dsimp only [...]` plus `change` in `ofFunctorColimitι_comp_filteredFlasqueResolutionSectionsIso_hom`. Also use the first lemma in `colimMapComparison_isIso` in place of `change IsIso (colimit.post ..)`.
findings.benefit: Users can simplify components of these comparison maps in the canonical form `colimit.post` or `colimit.ι`, which the existing `colimit.ι_post` rule then consumes. The proofs no longer need to restate long goals through `change`.

findings.excerpt: f n := colimit.ι (filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexDiagram F |>.X n) i
findings.problem: The stage-to-colimit maps are defined by components, with no simp lemma for `.f n`. The only simp-facing lemma around them is the `inv_f` lemma for the eval iso, and there is no companion `_hom_f`. As a result, `filteredFlasqueResolution_stage` and the sections-iso lemma must pass the definition names to `simp [filteredFlasqueResolutionι, filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexColimitι, ...]`. The latter then ends with a bare `rfl` after simp. This is an unfolding-based interface, and it exposes the underlying `colim.mapHomologicalComplex` terms.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp]` lemmas `filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexColimitι_f : (filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexColimitι F i).f n = colimit.ι (filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexDiagram F |>.X n) i`. Add `filteredFlasqueResolutionι_f : (filteredFlasqueResolutionι F i).f n = colimit.ι (...) i`, using the existing `filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexDiagramEvalIso_inv_f` to remove the identity. Add the matching `filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexDiagramEvalIso_hom_f`. The callers can then use plain `simp`, or `simp [toFlasqueResolution_f_zero]`, instead of unfolding definitions.
findings.benefit: The canonical form of `.f n` of these maps is a single `colimit.ι`, which simp can combine with `colimit.ι_post` and `ι_colimMap`. It also removes the dangling `rfl` after `simp` and keeps the definitions opaque to downstream users.

findings.excerpt:
noncomputable abbrev filteredFlasqueResolutionSectionsIso :=
  let G : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{0} X ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{0} :=
findings.problem: This is an `abbrev` whose body contains `let G` and `letI : G.Additive`. It is reducible, so simp and dsimp unfold it everywhere it appears, and the `let` and `letI` terms leak into goals. Its type is also inferred, not stated. As a result, lemmas about `.hom` and `.inv` of the iso cannot be keyed on a stable head symbol. The consumer lemma has to `dsimp only [filteredFlasqueResolutionSectionsIso, colimMapIso, asIso_hom, colimMapComparison]` and then `change` the goal into the explicit `colimit.post` form. The same file already supplies a global-looking `filteredFlasqueResolution_sections_additive` instance, but only as a `local instance`. The `letI` is there to work around that choice.
findings.proposed_change: Make the instance non-local, or state the additive instance on the `sections` functor directly. Then define `filteredFlasqueResolutionSectionsIso` as a plain `def` with an explicit type, `colimMapIso (SheafCohomology.CompactOpenSections.sections (⊤ : Opens X)) (filteredFlasqueResolutionComplexDiagram F)`, with no `let`. Add `@[simp] lemma filteredFlasqueResolutionSectionsIso_hom_f : (filteredFlasqueResolutionSectionsIso F).hom.f n = colimit.post _ _`. Alternatively, keep the `abbrev` and use the lemma `ofFunctorColimitι_comp_filteredFlasqueResolutionSectionsIso_hom` as the canonical rewrite rule.
findings.benefit: Simp-normal forms mention the named iso instead of an expanded `let`, and its `.hom` has a stable component lemma. Downstream rewriting, such as in `filteredFlasquePositiveColimitIso_hom`, no longer needs unfolding plus `change`.
